title: A Bad Case of Stripes
author: David Shannon
intro: Camilla Cream loves lima beans, but she never eats them. She worries a lot about what other people think of her.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.clue: They are a kind of bean.

questions.q: Why does Camilla never eat lima beans?

options.text: Her mum says they're bad for her
They are too hard to cook

questions.clue: She wants to fit in with the other children.
questions.yes: The other children dislike lima beans, so Camilla never eats them.

questions.q: When does Camilla first get the stripes?

options.text: On the first day of school
On the last day of the holidays

questions.clue: She was getting ready for school that morning.
questions.yes: Camilla got the stripes on the first day of school.

questions.q: What does Camilla do to get ready that morning?
questions.clue: She wants to look just right for school.
questions.yes: Camilla tried on more than forty outfits.

questions.q: Which doctor comes to see Camilla?
questions.clue: His name sounds like a bumblebee.
questions.yes: Dr. Bumble came to see Camilla.

questions.q: What happens when the children call out patterns?
questions.clue: Her skin does whatever pattern the children call out.
questions.yes: Camilla's skin changed into the patterns the children called out.

questions.q: How does Camilla feel when the children make fun of her?
questions.clue: The children laughed at her and called her names.
questions.yes: Camilla felt embarrassed when the children made fun of her.

questions.q: Why does the principal say Camilla must stay off school?

options.text: She was rude to a teacher

questions.clue: It is all because of her stripes.
questions.yes: The principal said Camilla's stripes were too distracting.

questions.q: Who camps out on Camilla's lawn?
questions.clue: They want to tell her story in the news.
questions.yes: Reporters camped out on Camilla's lawn.

questions.q: What grows on Camilla after the experts try their cures?
questions.clue: Some of these grow on plants and birds.
questions.yes: Camilla grew roots, berries, crystals, feathers and a long furry tail.

questions.q: What happens when Camilla is told to become one with her room?
questions.clue: She turns into part of her bedroom.

questions.q: Who knows how to make Camilla better?
questions.clue: She is an old lady, not a doctor.
questions.yes: An old woman knew what was wrong with Camilla.

questions.q: What is the cure for Camilla's stripes?
questions.clue: It is the food Camilla secretly loves.

questions.q: What happens when Camilla eats the lima beans?

options.text: She turns bright green all over
She floats up into the sky

questions.yes: Camilla turned back into her normal self.

questions.q: How does Camilla feel about being different at the end?
questions.clue: She eats lima beans now, whatever anyone says.
questions.yes: Camilla is happy being different, and she never gets stripes again.
